programme.title: 2CELLOS - Live in London
programme.desc: Live in London 2011: 2CELLOS - (concert film, England, 2011) ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Peter Gabriel - New Blood: Live in London
programme.desc: Peter Gabriel New Blood Live in London in 3Dimensions - (concert film, England, 2011) Filmed at the Hammersmith Apollo in March 2011, New Blood - Live In London captures Peter Gabriel performing live with the 46 piece New Blood Orchestra. The repertoire mixes cover versions from his Scratch My Back album with classic tracks from across his solo career in brand new orchestral arrangements. Gabriel is a renowned live performer and his onstage charisma and instantly recognisable voice combine brilliantly with the orchestral sound palette to breathe a new sense of wonder into familiar songs. As you would expect the concert is also a visual feast, with graphics, animation and imagery blending to enhance and illustrate the music. This is truly a live experience not to be missed., R.: Peter Gabriel, Ul.: Peter Gabriel

programme.title: Lindsey Buckingham - Songs From Small Machine: Live in L.A.
programme.desc: Lindsey Buckingham - Songs from the Small Machine, Live in LA - (concert film, United States of America, 2011) Filmed in high definition at an exclusive show at the Saban Theatre in Beverly Hills in April 2007, Songs From The Small Machine captures Lindsey Buckingham showcasing tracks from his studio album Seeds We Sow, songs from across his solo career and Fleetwood Mac classics. His distinctive guitar picking style and instantly recognisable voice are joined to his dynamic on stage presence to deliver a show that brings the audience to their feet and leaves them calling for more. Starting with five solo acoustic performances, Lindsey is then joined by his band to rock their way through the rest of the set before a final acoustic encore of Seeds We Sow brings a perfect evening to an end., R.: Lindsey Buckingham, Ul.: Lindsey Buckingham (Self)

programme.title: Ellie Goulding - Live at the iTunes Festival
programme.desc: Ellie Goulding - Live at the iTunes Festival - (concert film, England, 2015) Do not just be fascinated by the beauty and girlishness of this bright-eyed Englishwoman. Ellie Goulding has a lot more to offer fans of good pop music and its electronic variations. Since releasing her first album in 2010, Ellie has traveled the world to showcase her talents, both in the voice and in the composition of her songs. These talents can be seen in this show at the iTunes Festival in London, with special mention for the songs Burn, Halcyon, Lights and My Blood.

programme.title: Eric Clapton And Steve Winwood - Live from MSG
programme.desc: Eric Clapton And Steve Winwood - Live from MSG - (documentary, United States of America, 2009) History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out three-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in late February 2008 when icons Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their all-too-brief days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969. Whether they will ever team again is unknown. But with Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood Live From Madison Square Garden fans everywhere are able to experience the sound and the glory of a performance on that famous stage by two of rock's greatest artists., R.: Eric Clapton

programme.title: Jerry Lee Lewis - Jerry Lee Lewis and Friends
programme.desc: Jerry Lee Lewis: Jerry Lee Lewis And Friends - (concert film, England, 1989) Jerry Lee Lewis is one of the founding fathers of Rock n Roll. He was one of the original Sun Records quartet along with Elvis Presley, Carl Perkins and Johnny Cash who between them defined the music of a generation. His recording career has stretched from the mid-50s to the present day and his unique style of piano playing has influenced scores of musicians over the years. This concert, recorded at London's Hammersmith Apollo in 1989, features the killer in performances of his classic tracks such as Whole Lotta Shakin Goin On, What Id Say, High School Confidential and Great Balls Of Fire all delivered in his own inimitable fashion. Joining him on stage are a great list of guests including Van Morrison, Dave Edmunds, John Lodge, Brian May, Stuart Adamson and Dave Davies., R.: Jerry Lee Lewis

programme.title: Zelena milja
programme.desc: U odjelu za osuđenike na smrt na živote zatvorskih stražara utječe jedan od zatvorenika: crnac osuđen za ubojstva dviju djevojčica, koji posjeduje tajanstveni dar.

programme.title: Rat Charlieja Wilsona
programme.desc: Priča o tome kako su se kongresmen, koji je volio dobar provod, i odmetnuti agent CIA-e, koji je volio dobru borbu, udružili da bi izveli najveću tajnu operaciju svih vremena.

programme.title: Dolazak
programme.desc: Lingvist surađuje s vojskom kako bi komunicirao s izvanzemaljskim oblicima života nakon što se dvanaest misterioznih svemirskih letjelica pojavi u svijetu.

programme.title: Prevoditeljica
programme.desc: Političke spletke i obmane odvijaju se u Ujedinjenim narodima, gdje agent tajne službe istražuje prevoditeljicu koja tvrdi da je slučajno čula razgovor u kojem se planira atentat na predsjednika...

programme.title: Istjerivači duhova 3
programme.desc: Nakon invazije duhova na Manhattan, dva paranormalna entuzijasta, nuklearni inženjer i radnik podzemne željeznice, udruže snage da zaustave prijetnju.

programme.title: Zorro: Maskirani osvetnik
programme.desc: Mladog lopova, koji želi osvetiti smrt svog brata, obučava nekada veliki, a sada ostarjeli Zorro, koji traži vlastitu osvetu.

programme.title: Pet legendi
programme.desc: Kad zli duh Pitch pokrene napad na Zemlju, Besmrtni Čuvari udružuju se da zaštite nevinost djece diljem svijeta.

programme.title: Dvije sestre za kralja
programme.desc: Ova povijesna drama prati oštru borbu sestara Mary (Scarlett Johansson) i Anne Boleyn (Natalie Portman), dok se trude steći naklonost kralja Henrika VIII.

programme.title: Nestale
programme.desc: Novi Meksiko, 1885. godine. Mlada se majka prisiljena udružiti sa svojim otuđenim ocem nakon što joj kćer otme vrač iz plemena Apaša.

programme.title: Plesačice
programme.desc: Bezbrižna i mlada skitnica Nomi stiže u Las Vegas u Nevadi kako bi postala plesačica. Kreće na put do samog vrha zabavljačica.

programme.title: Sretan dan smrti
programme.desc: Studentica Theresa Gelbman nastavlja ponovno proživljavati dan kad je ubijena da bi otkrila identitet svojeg ubojice.

programme.title: Dilema
programme.desc: Dva najbolja prijatelja i poslovna partnera pokušavaju proslaviti svoju tvrtku kada jedan od njih vidi ženu drugog kako ljubi drugog muškarca te mora smisliti kako mu reći što je vidio.

programme.title: Kapetan Gaćeša: Prvi epski film
programme.desc: Dva ludo maštovita šaljivca hipnotiziraju mrzovoljnog ravnatelja da pomisli da je smiješno entuzijastičan, ali nevjerojatno glup superheroj u donjem rublju.

programme.title: Umijeće laganja
programme.desc: Komedija koja je smještena u svijet u kojem nitko ne laže, sve dok jedan pisac ne iskoristi priliku za osobnu korist.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Pojavljuje se divovsko, reptilsko čudovište koje sve uništava. Da zaustave čudovište, znanstvenik koji proučava gliste, njegova bivša djevojka i drugi neočekivani junaci udružuju se da spase grad.

programme.title: Legenda o Zorrou
programme.desc: Iako maksimalno pokušava izbjeći nove avanture, prijetnja nadolazećem statusu Kalifornije potiče pustolovnog Alejandra de la Vegu i njegovu suprugu Elenu na akciju.

programme.title: Pikseli
programme.desc: Kada vanzemaljci pogrešno protumače video zapise klasičnih arkadnih igara kao objavu rata, oni napadnu Zemlju u obliku videoigara.

programme.title: Ponos i predrasude
programme.desc: Životi pet sestara u georgijanskoj Engleskoj okrenu se naglavce kada se bogati mladić sa svojim prijateljem doseli u njihovo susjedstvo. Film je temeljen na romanu Jane Austen.

programme.title: Dobrodošli u Marwen
programme.desc: Žrtva brutalnog napada nalazi jedinstven i prekrasan terapeutski izlaz koji mu pomaže u procesu oporavka.

programme.title: Američka pita
programme.desc: Četiri tinejdžera sklapaju pakt da će izgubiti nevinost do maturalne večeri.

programme.title: Nestale

programme.title: MaksimUm
programme.desc: Zli genij konačno pobjeđuje svog dobrog neprijatelja, ali ostaje bez svrhe u svijetu bez superheroja.
